source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
-f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
            comm
    optimization:
        skip-unless-mozlint: stylelint.yml
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-node
            - node-modules

rejected-words:
    description: Reject some words we don't want to use in the code base
    treeherder:
        symbol: text(rejected-words)
        # We don't want patches to be backed out because of this, a follow up bug will be
        # good enough
        tier: 2
    run:
        mach: commlint -v -l rejected-words -f treeherder -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json comm
    when:
        files-changed:
            - '**/*.js'
            - '**/*.jsx'
            - '**/*.mjs'
            - '**/*.xml'
            - '**/*.html'
            - '**/*.xhtml'
            - '**/*.cpp'
            - '**/*.c'
            - '**/*.h'
            - '**/*.idl'
            - '**/*.webidl'
            - '**/*.configure'
            - '**/*.py'
            - '**/*.properties'
            - '**/*.rst'
            - '**/*.ftl'
            - '**/*.java'
